name: Harl Maddock
role: King of the Gralloch Crown — ended a four-way bandit feud by killing the other chiefs at a truce feast, and now takes tribute from every raider band within a week's ride
appearance: A broad, grey-bearded man in scarred plate with four mismatched rings on his left hand. Eats slowly, listens more than he talks, and never sits with his back to a door.
voiceHints: Reasonable, almost gentle. Explains exactly what he will do to you and why it is the sensible choice, then does it.
wants: The pass at Kestrel's Roost, and a crown that outlives him — which means sons he can trust, which means none.
fears: A fifth chief at a feast of his own.
knowledge: The strength, captain and loyalty of every band that pays him
Which caravans move through the Churn and when
That the Kestrel's ledger is the only thing standing between him and the pass

reactsToReputation.any: weighs whether you are cheaper to use or to kill
reactsToReputation.feared: offers you a band of your own
reactsToReputation.merciful: assumes you can be bled slowly

questSeeds: The Crown is massing to take Kestrel's Roost before winter
The sons of the four dead chiefs are still alive, and still in his bands
gear: four rings taken at a feast
title: King of the Gralloch
_domainsWhy: the Churn's disorder, a Marcher's violence, and a Syllogist's arithmetic — he is cruel by calculation
